div.div:
Reusable physical location; address snapshotted on orders.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
name: text [NN]
address: text [NN]
city: text [NN]
country_code: text [NN]
default 'KZ'
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
CK1: country_code = 'KZ'
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Versioned predefined layout; immutable after copied into a selling event.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
venue_id: uuid [FK NN]
name: text [NN]
version: integer [NN]
default 1
canvas_width: integer [NN]
canvas_height: integer [NN]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (venue_id, name, version)
UQ2: (id, venue_id)
CK1: version > 0 AND canvas_width > 0 AND canvas_height > 0
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(venue_id) -> venue(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Physical seat and accessibility metadata, not per-event availability.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
layout_id: uuid [FK NN]
row_id: uuid [FK NN]
label: text [NN]
price_category: text [NN]
is_accessible: boolean [NN]
default false
x: numeric(10,2) [NN]
y: numeric(10,2) [NN]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (row_id, label)
UQ2: (id, layout_id)
CK1: x >= 0 AND y >= 0
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(row_id, layout_id) -> venue_row(id, layout_id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.
